mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing business investment and consumer confidence, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank policy tightening that erodes real earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production decline below 100 for 3 months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, which generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when INDPRO remains below 100 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) signal labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumption, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1500 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing related sector activity and consumer confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 2.0% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 2.0%.
